description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay in minutes for each route.
transformation_or_derivation: Calculated by grouping flights by origin and destination and taking the mean of dep_delay.
notes_or_concerns: One missing value for EWR to LGA. Departure delay may not be available at prediction time, so using it could cause data leakage.

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Maximum arrival delay in minutes for each route.
transformation_or_derivation: Maximum arrival delay grouped by origin and dest.
notes_or_concerns: Four routes have negative maximum delays and only one flight each. Missing values are possible. This is known after arrival.

description: Average flight distance in miles for each route.
transformation_or_derivation: Average distance grouped by origin and dest.
notes_or_concerns: Check for missing or nonpositive distances.

description: Average time spent flying in minutes for each route.
transformation_or_derivation: Average air_time grouped by origin and dest.
notes_or_concerns: One route has a missing value. Air time is not known before the flight.

description: Full name of the destination airport
transformation_or_derivation: Joined from airports using dest = faa
notes_or_concerns: Missing for 7 routes whose destination (BQN, PSE, SJU, STT) is not in the airports table

transformation_or_derivation: Joined airport latitude using the destination code.
notes_or_concerns: Seven routes have missing coordinates because airport information was not matched.

transformation_or_derivation: Joined airport longitude using the destination code.
notes_or_concerns: Seven routes have missing coordinates because airport information was not matched.
